value.content: {"id": "recon_meth_008", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "recon", "name": "Search Engine Intelligence & GHDB (Google Hacking Database) Dorking", "prerequisites": ["osint_fundamentals", "search_engine_syntax"], "signals": ["ghdb_dork", "google_sheets_leak", "filetype_operator", "inurl_operator", "intext_operator"], "verification_strategy": "Construct targeted search engine queries using advanced boolean operators (site:, inurl:, intext:, filetype:) to detect exposed configuration spreadsheets, unprotected admin portals, and indexed credentials.", "evidence_requirements": ["search_engine_indexed_url", "exposed_sensitive_document_proof"], "remediation_pattern": "Deploy restrictive robots.txt with 'Disallow: /' on private paths, enforce 'X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow' HTTP headers, and remove sensitive internal documents from public cloud sharing.", "description": "Passive search engine intelligence leveraging Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo syntax to identify accidentally indexed corporate documents, database backups, and exposed spreadsheets."}
